summary: Underneath it, you swing between a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: Underneath it, you swing between a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you think and talk your way through anything; other days your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways. The work is holding both without picking a side. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
integration: Let thinking and speech and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
